digest.en: Asia-Pacific leads the board this hour with Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition. Middle East & Africa carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.

articles.title: Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition
articles.summary: Min Aung Hlaing transitioned from commander-in-chief to president in Five years after mounting a coup that ousted an elected civilian government, Min Aung Hlaing has overseen tightly staged elections transitioning him from commander-in-chief to president. Foreign governments should ensure interaction with Naypyitaw is calibrated, so as not to confer unwarranted legitimacy on the administration. articles.title: As Cease-Fire Brings Uneasy Calm, Iranians Wonder What Comes Next
